Overview

Koudougou is a city in Centre-Ouest with a population of 200,000. Koudougou is a major city in Burkina Faso with a population of 200,000. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. A relatively small share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 280 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews young, with a median age of 17.0.
